It's to take the robot out of the human"). The Pillar 5 angle: "AI isn't replacing your job. It's redefining what your job IS. The people who redefine their job first win. The people who wait get redefined out of a job."

## Source 3 — 网易 (NetEase) 2026: "2026年AI正在这样改变你的工作方式"

**Type:** Mainstream Chinese tech-media (163.com)
**Headline:** "2026年AI正在这样改变你的工作方式"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "你有没有发现,身边的同事越来越少提'加班'这个词了?不是工作变少了,是AI把重复性任务接了过去。2026年的职场,写周报、整理数据、排会议这些琐事,正在被自动化工具批量处理。"
> "工具越智能,对'人'的要求反而越刁钻。以前会用Excel就能混的岗位,现在需要你同时懂业务逻辑、会调教AI、还能在机器给出的十个方案里挑出真正靠谱的那个。"
> "团队里开始出现'AI协调员'这类角色,他们不写代码,专门负责让不同系统顺畅对话。"

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "AI把重复性任务接了过去" — AI took the repetitive tasks
- "AI协调员" — the new role: AI coordinator
- "你的工位没变,但工作流已经被重构了" — your desk didn't move, your workflow did

### Why this works:
The 网易 piece gives a clean operational picture: AI took weekly reports + data crunching + meeting scheduling. The new role is "AI coordinator" — a person who doesn't write code but orchestrates between AI systems. This is the 2026 version of the persona's "30-minutes-a-weekend" tactical play — it's now a job title, not a hobby. The Pillar 5 angle: "AI coordinator is a real job title in 2026. No code required. Your job is to make 4 AI systems talk to each other. The salary: $80K-$120K. The barrier: knowing which AI does what." **Strongest Pillar 5 hook candidate: "AI took your weekly reports. Your boss didn't fire you. They gave you a new title: AI coordinator. Same desk. New workflow. $15K raise."**

## Source 4 — 搜狐 (Sohu): 李彦宏 "AI替换的是脑力劳动的体力活" (WAIC 2024)

**Type:** Mainstream Chinese tech-media quoting 李彦宏 at WAIC 2024
**Headline:** "专家:AI替换的是脑力劳动的体力活"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "AI将替代脑力劳动的体力活?... AI技术的发展已经催生了一些全新的工作机会,如数据标注师和提示词工程师等。"
> "AI更多的是替代那些脑力劳动的体力活。例如,在处理大量数据和复杂分析时,AI可以帮助人类更高效地完成任务,但决策和创新等高层次的脑力劳动仍然需要人类的智慧和判断。"

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "脑力劳动的体力活" — the physical labor inside mental work
- "数据标注师和提示词工程师" — the new jobs created by AI
- "决策和创新等高层次的脑力劳动" — what AI can't replace

### Why this works:
The 李彦宏 framing — "AI replaces the physical labor inside mental work" — is the cleanest conceptual articulation of the Pillar 5 thesis. The Pillar 5 angle: "Your weekly report is brain-labor's physical work. AI takes it. Your strategic decision is brain-labor's creative work. You take it. The line is: anything you do by rote, AI does now. Anything you do by judgment, you still do. Move your time from the first to the second."
